answer: An ecological agent network deters Sybil attacks through multispectral ground attestation. Each agent authenticates by measuring botanical pigment absorption in native flora, such as juniper stands at dawn, correlating real-time irradiance with satellite feeds. An adversary faces unavoidable hardware and logistical costs deploying physical optical sensors across separate locations. However, local overcast weather degrades spectral fidelity, erroneously invalidating legitimate agents.
